pages.text: Upon consumption, summons an Apostle Servant with a 30-minute lifespan to fight for the player.$(br)Right-clicking an Apostle Servant will attract Apollyon to temporarily possess the apostle; Apollyon will depart after 5 minutes.

From the Plundered in the Nether Cult's church, you obtained some wondrous cod. It seems ordinary, yet appears to possess extraordinary potential.$(br)How could a fish be preserved for so long? Through some experiments, you infused it with the immortal divinity that has witnessed both wholeness and fragmentation, elevating it to transcendence.$(br)Undoubtedly, the Holy Prophet and his apostles favored this fish.$(br)$(br)They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over. — Matthew
